description: A man with shoulder-length wavy hair, in a dark frock coat with a white collar and a flower in his lapel, leans on a wooden rail in the foreground. Behind him, a judge in a white wig and black robe sits on a raised bench at upper right, and spectators sit in a dim, wood-paneled room. The style is a dark, painterly oil look, and the painting appears to run edge to edge. I see no visible text.
